settings.question: How does an audio reading work?
settings.answer: You select your preferred duration (10, 20, or 30 minutes) and submit your questions through our intake form. Kavita connects with you directly on WhatsApp at the confirmed time for a focused, 1-on-1 session.

settings.question: What is the difference between Premium and Standard booking?
settings.answer: Premium bookings are scheduled for the same day (subject to availability). Standard bookings are scheduled within 3 to 5 business days.

settings.question: How do Voice Note readings work?
settings.answer: After booking, submit your specific questions. Kavita channels the cards and records an intimate, personalized voice note sent directly to your WhatsApp.

settings.question: Are my questions and reading private?
settings.answer: Yes, completely. Every reading is held in strict sacred confidence. Your personal details and questions are never shared.
